name: MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder
author: gabrielwillkinson1

sections.description:
MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder connects your WordPress site to the MYAIO platform (https://app.myaio.com/) using an API key.

After activation, the plugin exposes secure REST API endpoints that allow the MYAIO platform to:
– Retrieve SEO-related site data for audits (titles, meta descriptions, headings, indexability signals, and selected on-page details), and
– If you enable deployment features, apply supported SEO updates such as Open Graph tags, Twitter cards, schema markup, canonical links, robots meta directives, and related settings.

The plugin does not automatically change your site. All deployment actions are initiated from the MYAIO platform after you connect your site and explicitly use those features.

MYAIO – Your AI-Powered Co-Founder does not promise rankings or traffic. SEO results depend on many external factors beyond the plugin’s control.

The plugin is designed to work alongside other SEO plugins (such as Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO) without replacing them.

Key Features

  • Secure API-key based connection to the MYAIO platform
  • Read-only SEO audit data endpoints
  • Optional deployment endpoints for supported SEO tags
  • Admin-controlled activation and configuration
  • No front-end output or visitor tracking by default
  • Compatible with existing SEO plugins

Getting Started

  1. Create an account at https://app.myaio.com/
  2. Generate an API key from your MYAIO dashboard.
  3. Enter the API key in the plugin settings.
  4. Run audits and manage recommendations from the MYAIO platform.

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to provide audit and deployment functionality. All external requests occur only as a result of explicit administrator actions or when a related feature is used.

MYAIO Platform

What it is:
The MYAIO web platform available at https://app.myaio.com/.

What it is used for:
Verifying the API key, managing the connection status, running SEO audits, and initiating optional SEO deployment actions.

What data is sent:
When the administrator verifies the API key, the plugin sends:
– The site URL
– An API key identifier
– Plugin connection status information

SEO-related site data (such as page URLs, titles, meta descriptions, headings, schema, and indexability signals) is accessed by the MYAIO platform via the plugin’s REST API endpoints only when the administrator explicitly initiates audits or deployment actions.

When data is sent or accessed:
Only when initiated by the site administrator (for example, verifying the API key or running audits).

SEOReviewTools

What it is:
An external SEO metrics service used for authority-related measurements.

What data is sent:
The site URL being evaluated and an API key required by that service.

When data is sent:
Only when the related metric or audit feature is used.

Privacy Policy:
https://www.seoreviewtools.com/privacy-policy-seo-review-tools/

Google APIs

What they are:
Google services used for optional SEO reporting features, including:
– Google PageSpeed Insights API
– Google Search Console API
– Google Analytics Data API
– Google Ads API (for keyword-related insights, where applicable)

What data is sent:
Depending on the service, site URLs, property identifiers, customer IDs, or query parameters required to retrieve metrics.

When data is sent:
Only when the site administrator enables and uses the related audit or reporting feature that requires the Google service.

Terms:
https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin does not add front-end scripts or track site visitors by default.

External requests are performed only when initiated by the site administrator or when using a feature that requires an external service. API keys are stored in WordPress options and are not exposed publicly.

Uninstall

When the plugin is deleted, it removes its stored options and temporary data. It does not modify WordPress core files, themes, or unrelated content.

Website

https://app.myaio.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP and activate it.
  2. Open the plugin settings page in WordPress admin.
  3. Enter your MYAIO API key and save to verify the connection.
